title: Hot Stamping Foil for UV-Printed Paper Boxes

seo.title: Hot Stamping Foil for UV-Printed Paper Boxes

content:
UV-printed paper boxes need careful foil selection because the top surface is different from ordinary paper.

## Why It Matters

A foil that works on blank paper may not perform the same on UV ink or UV varnish. The final printed sheet should always be tested.

## How to Choose

Use a foil grade suitable for printed and coated paper surfaces. Test small text, the logo and one solid area on the actual production sheet.

## Process Advice

Adjust temperature and machine settings gradually. If the result is weak, the foil may not match the coated surface. If the edge is unclear, the setting may be too strong.

## FAQ

### Can foil be used on UV varnish?

Yes, but the foil grade must match the coated surface.

## Sample Support

Send your UV-printed sheet and target foil color. We can recommend suitable foil grades.
